content.bridge_context: Exploring the distribution and movements of water on Earth.

units.title: Water Distribution
units.explanation: 97% is salt water (oceans). Only 3% is fresh water (glaciers, ground water, rivers).
units.dual_language_instruction: Is there more land or water on Earth? / पृथ्वी पर भूमि अधिक है या जल?

units.title: Ocean Circulation
units.dual_language_instruction: Notice the movement of water at a beach. / समुद्र तट पर जल की हलचल पर ध्यान दें।
